keyword.zh: 电动20型混凝土泵电机或柴油动力格

title.en: Work (physics) does not replace what Power Cell Electric 20 Concrete Pump Prints lists
title.zh: 「功」不能替换电动20型混凝土泵的动力格子印了什么列出的数字

description.en: Power Cell Electric 20 Concrete Pump Prints. 22 kW stays in the catalogue entry. Illustration: Work (physics).
description.zh: 电动20型混凝土泵的动力格子印了什么。22 kW仍在目录格子里。插图来自「功」。

h1.en: Work (physics) does not replace what Power Cell Electric 20 Concrete Pump Prints lists
h1.zh: 「功」不能替换电动20型混凝土泵的动力格子印了什么列出的数字

directAnswer.en: Hebei Pinjin Machinery lists the Electric 20 Concrete Pump power text in Xingtai as: Motor Power is 22 kW. An electric motor entry is kilowatts on a motor. The picture is from https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Work_(physics).
directAnswer.zh: 河北品锦机械在邢台把电动20型混凝土泵的动力文字写成：电机功率是22 kW。画面「Induction motor」的主体是Silniki by Zureks。图片来自https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Work_(physics)。

body.en: The figure is the one published at https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Work_(physics): Work (physics). Hebei Pinjin Machinery lists the Electric 20 Concrete Pump power text in Xingtai as: Motor Power is 22 kW. It does not change this power entry, and a diesel code is not copied onto an electric row. Output Capacity remains 8–10 m³/h. Hopper capacity is 0.25 m³. A larger motor entry is not a longer pipeline.
body.zh: 这张图是https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Work_(physics)页上的Work (physics)。河北品锦机械在邢台把电动20型混凝土泵的动力文字写成：电机功率是22 kW。

body.en: An electric motor entry is kilowatts on a motor. Motor Power is 22 kW. Max. Outlet Pressure remains 10 MPa. Maximum aggregate size is 1–2 cm.
body.zh: 画面「Induction motor」的主体是Silniki by Zureks。

body.en: A diesel entry names the engine line that is actually shown. Electric drive and diesel drive are different supplies. Hebei Pinjin Machinery does not lift kilowatts or an engine code out of that frame. Delivery Pipe Diameter 80 mm.
body.zh: 它不改这一格动力，也不会把柴油机代号抄到电动行上。

body.en: The frame “Induction motor” shows Silniki by Zureks. Use the label on this sheet, not the neighbouring model's label. If this row has no voltage entry, none is invented. Those entries, when shown, stay in their own columns.
body.zh: 河北品锦机械不从这一帧里提取千瓦或发动机代号。

question.en: What power text does Electric 20 Concrete Pump list?
question.zh: 电动20型混凝土泵的动力文字是什么？

answer.en: Motor Power is 22 kW. It is not a figure printed inside https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Work_(physics).
answer.zh: 电机功率是22 kW。它不是https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Work_(physics)画面里印出的数字。

question.en: On this row: Can a diesel code be moved onto this row?
question.zh: 可以把柴油机代号挪到这一行吗？

answer.en: Only if this row already lists it. Otherwise the entry stays as written. It is not a figure printed inside https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Work_(physics).
answer.zh: 只有这一行已经标出了才能算。否则格子保持原样。它不是https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Work_(physics)画面里印出的数字。

question.en: On this row: What are output and pressure on this sheet?
question.zh: 这一页的输送量和压力是多少？

answer.en: Output Capacity is 8–10 m³/h. Max. Outlet Pressure is 10 MPa. It is not a figure printed inside https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Work_(physics).
answer.zh: 理论输送量是8–10 m³/h。最大出口压力是10 MPa。它不是https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Work_(physics)画面里印出的数字。
